studies.title: Tengeh Reservoir
studies.finding: Three 2021 polygons match the commercial site.
studies.takeaway: The earlier polygon predates construction and lies outside the mapped commercial boundary.
studies.limitations: These three polygons total 10.4 ha in the saved extract. PUB describes ten commercial floating islands, so this is partial geometry. Mapped hectares do not establish MWp, output or complete construction.

studies.title: Sidrap I
studies.finding: 27 points match the mapped turbine layout.
studies.takeaway: Three of the 30 reference positions have no corresponding point in the saved extract.
studies.limitations: References 19, 24 and 27 have no corresponding point in this saved GRW extract. That does not mean the turbines are absent. The approximate community map corroborates attribution and is not an as-built engineering survey. No MW estimate is derived.
